# Archive Commands

Every command the `archive` module offers, from its declarations, in order of the resource each acts on. Each command's help says the same.

## `lnk archive export`

Write the things you select to one archive

```usage
lnk archive export [--all] [--from <from>] [--select <select>] [--to <to>]
```

- `--all`, boolean: Every thing here of every kind that exports
- `--from`, path: An archive kept as a folder, archive.toml at its top, to write as one .tar.gz [default name: the folder's]
- `--select`, string: The things to export, comma-separated, each as <kind>.<name>: agent.programmer,agent.work
- `--to`, path: The archive to write, a new .tar.gz file [default: in `~/Link/Archive`]

It answers `core.report`.

## `lnk archive import`

Import the things in an archive on disk, each as a new one

```usage
lnk archive import <path> [--select <select>]
```

It takes `path`, position 1, path, required: The archive, a .tar.gz file on disk. It takes `--select`, string: Only these things, each as <kind>.<name>, or <kind>.<name>=<kind>.<new name> to import it under another name. It answers `core.report`.
